# Quarry

> Quarry (Quarry Design Group, LLC) is a senior, distributed product &
> engineering firm. We design, build, and run digital products that move
> revenue. Founded 2016. Medford, OR + worldwide. $210M+ in client revenue
> on platforms we've built and maintain.

## Purpose
Quarry exists to build software that respects the humans on both sides of
the screen. Products that are accessible to all while protecting privacy,
attention, and autonomy. Crafted by a distributed collective grounded in
equity and trust.

## What we do
- Product ownership & design
- Full-stack engineering
- AI development & integration (AI as a product, AI as a feature)
- eCommerce engineering
- Data engineering & modernization (privacy-first)

## Key pages
- [Work](https://quarry.team/work): case studies (real, outcome-led)
- [Services](https://quarry.team/services): capabilities & engagement models (project, embedded, fractional)
- [AI Services](https://quarry.team/ai-services): AI development services - agents, retrieval (RAG), and LLM features shipped with evals & guardrails
- [Compliance](https://quarry.team/compliance): evidence of delivery in regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI DSS, privacy regimes)
- [How we use AI](https://quarry.team/how-we-use-ai): AI as leverage with senior judgment; deliberate, no slop
- [Team](https://quarry.team/team): the people (senior alumni of Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Adobe)
- [Careers](https://quarry.team/careers): open roles and how we hire
- [Insights](https://quarry.team/blog): writing on product, engineering, data & craft
- [Contact](https://quarry.team/contact): start a project (reply within one business day)
- [Policies](https://quarry.team/policies): governance and legal documents, plain language, dated
- [Grievances & Concerns](https://quarry.team/policies/grievances): raise a concern about our work, anonymously if you prefer; acknowledged within 5 business days
- [Responsible Marketing & Public Relations Policy](https://quarry.team/policies/responsible-marketing): how we market ourselves and speak publicly - truthful claims, no manipulative patterns, accessible content, opt-in email, AI disclosure
- [Climate Action Plan](https://quarry.team/policies/climate-action-plan): how we measure, reduce, and report our greenhouse gas emissions - 2026 baseline, Scope 3 focus, reduction targets, efficient software by default
- [Responsible Lobbying & Public Policy Engagement Policy](https://quarry.team/policies/responsible-lobbying): how we engage on public policy - positive-impact topics only, evidence-based positions, no political contributions, transparent engagement, accountable intermediaries
- [Justice, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion & Human Rights Policy](https://quarry.team/policies/jedi-human-rights): how we respect human rights and treat people fairly - equal pay for equal work, structured hiring, inclusive remote work, rights-respecting software, vendor and client screening
